title: APICircle Mock Server
description: Schema for `.mock.yaml` documents projected from `WorkspaceSynced.mockServers[id]`. Editable fields: `name`, `defaultPort`, `cors`. `source` + `endpoints` are read-only annotations — re-import to change.

name.description: Mock-server display name shown in the Mock view and run notifications.

defaultPort.description: Default port. null = pick a free port when starting.

origins.description: Allowed Origin header values. Empty + enabled=true means "reflect any origin".

source.description: Read-only — re-import the spec via 'APICircle: New Mock' to change. Spec content is intentionally NOT serialized in this projection (secret-safety) — only `kind`, `format`, and `bytes` are emitted.

bytes.description: Byte length of the raw spec stored in workspace.json. Read-only.

endpoints.description: Read-only — derived from source. Per-endpoint editing lives in the desktop app.
